instruction: Work from `/home/user/Desktop/tsr_scan.fst`, `/home/user/Desktop/elasto_tsr_base.dat`, and an NREL 5 MW dependency set. Complete a fixed-speed tip-speed-ratio sweep from the command line. 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/run_sweep.py` to generate four ElastoDyn files from the template: `elasto_rpm6.dat`, `elasto_rpm9.dat`, `elasto_rpm12.dat`, and `elasto_rpm15.dat`, with `RotSpeed` set to 6, 9, 12, and 15 rpm respectively. 2. Generate matching main files `case_rpm6.fst`, `case_rpm9.fst`, `case_rpm12.fst`, and `case_rpm15.fst`. In every main file set `TMax=30`, `DT_Out=0.1`, `OutFileFmt=1`, use `5MW_Baseline/NRELOffshrBsline5MW_InflowWind_Steady8mps.dat`, and reference the matching ElastoDyn file. Keep the fixed-speed structural configuration (`GenDOF=False`, `CompServo=0`). 3. Create `/home/user/Desktop/aerodyn_tsr.dat` from the supplied AeroDyn file, correct its dependency paths to `5MW_Baseline/...`, add the native AeroDyn channel `RtAeroPwr`, and reference it from all four main files. Run every case with `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast`; retain `case_rpm<RPM>.out` and `case_rpm<RPM>.log`, and require normal termination. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py` to read `RtAeroPwr` in watts from each text output and average it over the final 10 seconds. Compute `TSR = (rpm*2*pi/60)*63/8` and `Cp = mean_RtAeroPwr_W/(0.5*1.225*pi*63^2*8^3)`. `RtAeroPwr` is already in W; if `GenPwr` is ever used instead, its kW values must be multiplied by 1000 before this SI calculation. 5. Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` with four rows ordered by 6, 9, 12, and 15 rpm, each formatted `rpm,tsr,cp`. Do not use GUI tools. [Init Package Note] Additional initialization dependencies are pre-uploaded under `/home/user/Desktop` with relative structure preserved. Only initialization inputs are included; no answer/result artifacts are preloaded.
